Short title and commencement

ACT XV OF 1994
ACT XV OF 1994
DANGEROUS DRUGS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
An Act further to amend the Dangerous Drugs Act, 1930
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 7th August, 1994]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 3rd
August, 1994 and are hereby published for general information:
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Dangerous Drugs (Amendment) Act, 1994.
(2) 1t shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 4, Act II of 1930

ACT XV OF 1994
ACT XV OF 1994
DANGEROUS DRUGS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
An Act further to amend the Dangerous Drugs Act, 1930
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 7th August, 1994]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 3rd
August, 1994 and are hereby published for general information:
2. Amendment of section 4, Act II of 1930.--In the Dangerous Drugs
Act, 1930 (II of 1930), hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section 4,
in subsection (1),--
(i) in clause (d), the word
"raw" shall be omitted; and
(ii) in clause (e), the word
"raw" shall be omitted.

Amendment of section 10, Act 11 of 1930

ACT XV OF 1994
ACT XV OF 1994
DANGEROUS DRUGS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
An Act further to amend the Dangerous Drugs Act, 1930
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 7th August, 1994]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 3rd
August, 1994 and are hereby published for general information:
3. Amendment of section 10, Act 11 of 1930.-- In the said Act, in
section 10, for subsection (2) the following shall be substituted, namely:--
"(2) Whoever--
(a) possesses heroin or cocaine
in excess of ten grams or opium or coca leaf in excess of one kilogram shall be
punished with imprisonment for life or with imprisonment which shall not be
less than two years, and shall also be liable to fine; and
(b) traffics in, or finances the
trafficking of heroin, or cocaine or opium or coca leaf shall be punished with
death or with imprisonment for life or with imprisonment which shall not be
less than five years, and shall also be liable to fine.".
